steps.question_en: How long have you had this headache? (e.g., 2 hours, 1 day)
steps.question_sw: Umekuwa na maumivu ya kichwa kwa muda gani? (mfano: 2 saa, 1 siku)

steps.question_en: On a scale of 1-10, how severe is the pain? (1 = mild, 10 = severe)
steps.question_sw: Kwa kiwango cha 1-10, maumivu yanakuburuta kiasi gani? (1 = kidogo, 10 = sana)

steps.question_en: Do you have any of these: fever, nausea, vision problems, stiff neck? (yes/no)
steps.question_sw: Unao na hayo mambo: homa, kutokupenda kula, matatizo ya macho, shingo kali? (ndiyo/hapana)

headache.advice_en:
⚠️ HEADACHE ADVICE

General recommendations:
- Drink plenty of water
- Rest in a dark, quiet room
- Avoid stress and strenuous activities
- Consider paracetamol if appropriate

⚠️ IMPORTANT: This is not a medical diagnosis. 

⛔ SEEK IMMEDIATE CARE if:
- Headache is sudden and very severe ("thunderclap")
- You have fever, stiff neck, or confusion
- You have vision changes or severe nausea
- Headache lasts more than a few days

Visit a health facility if symptoms persist or worsen.
headache.advice_sw:
⚠️ USHAURI WA MAUMIVU YA KICHWA

Mapendekezo ya jumla:
- Kunywa maji mengi
- Lala mahali salama na sato
- Kuepusha dhiki na kazi ngumu
- Zingatia dawa kama inapaswa

⚠️ MUHIMU: Hii sio diagnosis ya kimatibabu.

⛔ TAFUTA MSAADA WA HARAKA ikiwa:
- Maumivu yanaanza ghafla na yanaburuta sana
- Una homa, shingo kali, au utata
- Una matatizo ya macho au kutokupenda kula kwa wazimu
- Maumivu yanaendelea kwa siku kadhaa

tembelea kituo cha afya kama dalili zinaendelea au kuongekwa.

steps.question_en: How long have you had fever? (e.g., 1 day, 3 days)
steps.question_sw: Umekuwa na homa kwa muda gani? (mfano: 1 siku, 3 siku)

steps.question_en: Do you know your temperature? (e.g., 38.5°C, or just say 'high')
steps.question_sw: Je, unajua kiwango chako cha joto? (mfano: 38.5°C, au sema 'joto zaidi')

steps.question_en: Do you have: body aches, cough, vomiting, or diarrhea? (yes/no)
steps.question_sw: Je, unao: maumivu ya mwili, kikohozi, kutapika, au kuvimba? (ndiyo/hapana)

fever.advice_en:
⚠️ FEVER ADVICE

General care:
- Rest and avoid strenuous activities
- Drink plenty of fluids (water, warm tea)
- Keep cool: use light clothing and cool water compresses
- Take paracetamol or ibuprofen as appropriate
- Monitor your temperature

⚠️ IMPORTANT: This is not a medical diagnosis.

⛔ SEEK CARE at a health facility if:
- Fever lasts more than 3-5 days
- Temperature is above 39°C
- You have severe body aches or weakness
- You have difficulty breathing
- You have signs of dehydration (dry mouth, dark urine)
- You are a young child or elderly person

Suspected malaria? Visit a clinic for testing.
fever.advice_sw:
⚠️ USHAURI WA HOMA

Kudumisha afya:
- Lala na epusha kazi ngumu
- Kunywa maji mengi (maji, chai joto)
- Jisikie baridi: kutumia nguo nyepesi na maji ya baridi
- Zingatia paracetamol au ibuprofen inapaswa
- Fuatilia kiwango chako cha joto

⚠️ MUHIMU: Hii sio diagnosis ya kimatibabu.

⛔ TAFUTA MSAADA katika kituo cha afya ikiwa:
- Homa inaendelea zaidi ya 3-5 siku
- Joto linakuzidi 39°C
- Una maumivu makubwa ya mwili au dhaifu
- Unao na matatizo ya kupumzika
- Una dalili za mkate (kinywa kavu, mkate nyingi)
- Wewe ni mtoto mdogo au mtu mzee

Shaka malaria? Tembelea kliniki kwa jaribio.

steps.question_en: How long have you had this stomach pain? (e.g., 1 hour, overnight)
steps.question_sw: Umekuwa na maumivu ya tumboni kwa muda gani? (mfano: 1 saa, usiku)
Ka matokeo ya maumivu: 1-3 (kidogo), 4-6 (kawaida), 7-10 (sana). Ni ipi?

steps.question_en: Do you have: nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or constipation? (yes/no or describe)
steps.question_sw: Je, unao: kutokupenda kula, kutapika, kuvimba, au kuumiza? (ndiyo/hapana au eleza)

stomach_pain.advice_en:
⚠️ STOMACH PAIN ADVICE

General care:
- Rest and avoid heavy foods
- Drink clear fluids: water, broth, herbal tea
- Eat light foods gradually (rice, bananas, bread)
- Avoid dairy, spicy, and greasy foods
- Consider antacids if appropriate
- Use a warm compress for comfort

⚠️ IMPORTANT: This is not a medical diagnosis.

⛔ SEEK URGENT CARE if:
- Pain is severe (7+/10) or worsening
- You have persistent vomiting
- You cannot keep fluids down
- You have blood in stool or vomit
- You have high fever with severe pain
- You have signs of dehydration
- Pain lasts more than a few hours with no improvement

If stomach pain persists beyond a day, visit a health facility.
stomach_pain.advice_sw:
⚠️ USHAURI WA MAUMIVU YA TUMBONI

Kudumisha afya:
- Lala na epusha chakula kizito
- Kunywa maji safi: maji, moto, chai ya majani
- Kula chakula nyepesi kwa hatua (wali, ndizi, mkate)
- Epusha maziwa, chakula kinachoburuta, na mafuta
- Zingatia dawa ya antacid inapaswa
- Tumia kitambaa cha joto kwa ushindi

⚠️ MUHIMU: Hii sio diagnosis ya kimatibabu.

⛔ TAFUTA MSAADA WA HARAKA ikiwa:
- Maumivu yanakuburuta sana (7+/10) au kuongekwa
- Una kutapika kwa mwendelezo
- Huwezi kuendelea na kunywa
- Una mkate au kutapika kwa mkate
- Una joto la juu na maumivu makubwa
- Una dalili za mkate
- Maumivu yanaendelea zaidi ya saa kadhaa bila ushindi

Kama maumivu yanaendelea zaidi ya siku, tembelea kituo cha afya.
